checks.criterion: Home storefront loads with mobile-first luxury shell, announcement, navigation, hero CTA, featured fragrances, scent finder, review and news sections
checks.name: home-storefront-shell
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed at mobile viewport: hero contains MAKE MY PERFUME, Explore collection CTA, seeded Citrus Noir, scent finder, review and news sections.

checks.criterion: Collections support seeded product discovery, live search, mood filters, sorting, and product detail navigation
checks.name: collection-search-filter-detail
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed: Citrus Noir discovery, live search narrowing, Fresh mood filter, and detail navigation with image, rating, notes, Buy now and stock state.

checks.criterion: Guest cart supports add-to-cart drawer, quantity controls, removal, and persistence
checks.name: guest-cart-drawer-persistence
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed: add opens drawer, count and quantity controls work, close/reopen retains item, and remove empties cart.

checks.criterion: Buy-now and cart checkout reach a guest checkout without login
checks.name: guest-checkout-reachable
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed: Buy now reaches guest checkout with name, email, Indian phone/address/city/state/PIN fields and prepaid/COD choices.

checks.criterion: Checkout pricing is transparent and updates by payment method
checks.name: checkout-transparent-pricing
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed: ₹1,200 Citrus Noir summary shows GST 18%, free shipping, prepaid savings ₹120, and COD handling fee ₹80 after switching method.

checks.criterion: Valid guest prepaid order completes through the payment boundary
checks.name: guest-prepaid-order-confirmation
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed: valid guest prepaid submission reaches confirmation with MMP reference, payable amount, and payment confirmed in demo mode boundary status.

checks.criterion: News, About, Contact, policies, and newsletter surfaces are reachable and usable
checks.name: content-contact-newsletter-policies
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed: content and policy navigation works, contact validation and valid success state work, and newsletter surface is usable.

checks.criterion: Mobile accessibility and interaction quality are acceptable
checks.name: mobile-accessibility-no-overflow
checks.evidence: Named browser check rerun passed at mobile viewport: menu reveals six navigation links, cart/menu controls are named, focus/interaction works, and document has no horizontal overflow.

checks.criterion: Collections support seeded product discovery, live search, mood filters, sorting, and product detail navigation
checks.name: backend-catalog
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: GET /api/products search and Fresh filter plus GET /api/products/citrus-noir returned 200 with seeded data; missing slug returned 404.

checks.criterion: Checkout pricing is transparent and updates by payment method; valid guest prepaid order completes through payment boundary
checks.name: backend-commerce
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: checkout preview pricing, COD fee, mocked order confirmation/idempotency, and invalid PIN 422 behavior.

checks.criterion: News, About, Contact, policies, and newsletter surfaces are reachable and usable
checks.name: backend-content
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: news/detail GETs, subscriber POST, valid contact POST, and short contact message 422.
